Name: AT - Curios of the Pumpkin Queen
Author: TerraTerraCotta
Description:
Curios of the Pumpkin Queen is a set of Pumpkin-themed furniture inspired by my OC, [url=https://toyhou.se/3965220.terra-lavee]Terra Lavee[/url].

[b][size=3][u]Current List of Pumpkin Furniture:[/u][/size][/b]
-A Set of Pumpkin TVs, with or without Jack O' Lantern Eyes, which can be retextured over the [b]Plasma, Floor, and Budget TV
[/b]-A Set of Vined Pumpkins, or Pumpkin on A Table with Candles that act as working lamps. Can be retextured over the [b]Candle Lamp, Classic Lamp, Country Lamp, and Ornate Lamp
[/b]-A Set of Pumpkin and Vine Wall Sconces that act as working wall lamps. They can be retextured over any [b]Wall Sconce
[/b]-A Pumpkin-themed Bench, which can be retextured over the [b]Birch, Mahogany, Oak, or Walnut Benches
[/b]-A set of two small decorative Pumpkins together, can be retextured over the [b]Decorative Bowl, Decorative Lantern, Small Plant, or Table Plant[/b]
-A purely decorative Pumpkin Carriage, which can be retextured over the [b]Deluxe Tree and Exotic Tree[/b]

I plan to update this periodically with new pieces of furniture as I get inspired, and as they get suggested. So if there's a piece of Pumpkin furniture you'd like to see please comment on this mod so I can add it to the list.

All of the current furniture has been testing and should work, but if something happens that's not Alternative Textures causing it (i.e. a visual oddity) please let me know)

[b][u]Future Plans[/u][/b]
-Add more Pumpkin-Themed Furniture[i] (Of course)[/i]
-Add some actual Terra Lavee-themed furniture for people who want that [i](I've made a few but not enough to justify an additional pack yet)[/i]
